request: If this is a spanner, the main cutout is too deep which is weakening the tool. Make the cutout shallower by 10mm, but keep the "size" of the spanner the same - meaning the parallel surfaces remain 20mm apart.

actions.operation: Reduce the depth of the main cutout.
actions.target: The main cutout of the spanner.
actions.relational_constraint: The cutout must become 10 mm shallower relative to its existing depth.
actions.unresolved_reference: Identify the main cutout and determine its existing depth direction and the geometry that controls that depth.

actions.operation: Preserve the spanner size by maintaining the specified separation between the parallel surfaces.
actions.target: The parallel surfaces defining the spanner size.
actions.relational_constraint: The surfaces must remain parallel and 20 mm apart after the cutout depth is reduced.
actions.unresolved_reference: Identify the pair of parallel surfaces in the CAD model that defines the spanner size.

intention: Reduce weakening of the tool caused by the excessively deep main cutout.
Retain the same functional spanner size while making the cutout shallower.
